claims.claim: Zscaler FY2026 revenue and ARR each grew 25% year over year, reaching $3.353B revenue and $3.771B ARR.
Management reports expanding demand across Zero Trust SASE, Agentic SecOps, Data Security and Security for AI, with AI agents creating both security demand and deployment opportunities.
Red Canary contributed $141M of Q4 ARR; excluding it, ARR growth was 20% rather than the reported 25%.

risks.risk: Acquisition contribution lifts headline ARR growth; organic growth is lower and competitive cybersecurity markets can compress growth or pricing.

unknowns.unknown: Incremental monetization specifically attributable to agentic-AI security remains difficult to separate from broader platform adoption.

claims.claim: Q4 FY2026 revenue was $898.2M, up 25%, and non-GAAP operating margin reached a record 24%.
FY2026 operating cash flow was $1.130B and free cash flow $779.1M, though free-cash-flow margin declined to 23% from 27% in FY2025.
GAAP operating loss improved in Q4 to $15.5M from $32.2M a year earlier, but full-year GAAP net loss widened to $63.2M from $41.5M.

risks.risk: GAAP profitability remains negative and free-cash-flow margin contracted despite strong top-line and non-GAAP margin execution.

contradictions.contradiction: Record non-GAAP operating margin and strong cash generation coexist with a wider full-year GAAP net loss and lower free-cash-flow margin.

unknowns.unknown: Durability of 20% organic ARR growth after acquisition normalization and the path to sustained GAAP profitability remain uncertain.
